apps.name: Erosion-CN
apps.subtitle: iOS / iPadOS 系统配置与 MobileGestalt 研究工具箱（中英双语）
apps.localizedDescription:
Erosion-CN 是面向 iOS / iPadOS 27.0–27.2.1 & 27.3 beta 1（及 26.x 部分功能）的中英双语系统配置与 MobileGestalt 研究工具箱（防白苹果安全加固版）。

• 原位覆盖写入（pwrite + F_FULLFSYNC）与写后全量读回校验，杜绝重启反弹与 0 字节白苹果
• 无损 CoreFoundation 类型直通，根治相机取景黑屏
• 运行时动态解析 libMobileGestalt.dylib 槽位 + 双金库 SHA-256 备份一键恢复原厂
• 支持国行 Apple 智能解锁、海外 eSIM 与 FaceTime 音频开启、应用存档备份、缓存清理与电池/崩溃诊断

⚠️ 签名要求：安装时请务必保留 App Group 权限（SideStore / AltStore / Feather 默认支持）。

Bilingual (English + Simplified Chinese) bootloop-hardened MobileGestalt & cross-container research toolkit for iOS/iPadOS 27.x. Requires at least one App Group entitlement when signing.

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Anti-Recreate Sentinel Lock (`0555` + `0444` `.erosion_adlock`) / 防重建占位锁加固**

- **搜索优先显示已下架应用**：关键词搜索结合内置应用别名目录及本机已购、收藏、下载记录做相关度分级匹配，并核验候选应用的下架状态，将已确认下架且匹配关键词的应用优先排在结果前排；可在「账号 › 设置 › 下载 › 搜索时优先显示已下架应用」随时关闭恢复原排序（默认开启）。
- **下载操作与按钮形变动效**：下载、已购、搜索与详情页的操作按钮、云朵按钮与黑白进度环统一居中对齐，点按后以按钮中心平滑形变为加载/下载环；进度环底轨与前景进度弧统一为相同线宽，状态过渡更连贯。
- **侧滑动画与 5 秒撤销**：下载卡片侧滑垃圾桶与分享图标显露后由原生 Core Animation 播放完整动画（开启「减少动态效果」时显示静态完整图标）；下载卡片侧滑删除不再弹确认窗，改为 5 秒倒计时与撤销（连续删除可合并撤销），长按「删除任务及文件」与批量删除仍保留确认，搜索记录删除不再显示倒计时或撤销。
- **底部标签栏与同步骨架屏微光**：底部标签栏改为自适应动态矢量图标并统一描边粗细，优化搜索图标视觉重量与账号页切换动画；加载骨架屏改为全屏同相位的单色扫光（shimmer），并统一列表轻按触感与轻量化确认弹窗。

- **下载列表、内联更新说明与图标开关**：精简下载任务展示与状态文案，任务信息区分商店版本、包内版本、构建号与商店版本 ID，支持在应用详情内联展开更新说明；可在「设置 › 下载 › 显示历史版本图标」按需关闭历史图标读取以节省流量和加载时间（已缓存图标仍保留）。

### 修复与稳定性

- **修复本机配对灵动岛提醒**：本机配对期间按序更新灵动岛状态，后台优先通过灵动岛实时展示配对进度与验证码，仅在灵动岛未激活时回退系统通知，并优化深色模式下配对步骤徽章对比度。

- **界面布局调整**：统一对齐发现页与搜索页的最近搜索标题和芯片外边距，避免圆角被容器裁切。
- 继续支持 iOS / iPadOS 16 及更新版本，各功能保留各自系统版本要求（直接替换翻译需 iOS 18+）。

- `iPadn-2.1.2-lite-unsigned.ipa`：精简版，不含扩展，只需 1 个 App ID；不提供实时活动或小组件，其他功能相同。

This release improves delisted-app keyword search priority, action-button morph animations, swipe feedback, historical version matching and pairing Live Activity alerts, adds opt-in in-place translation on iOS 18+, and strengthens native install stability.

- **Prioritize delisted apps in search**: Keyword search combines the app alias directory with local purchased, favorite and download records for tiered relevance matching, verifies candidate delisted status, and places confirmed matching delisted apps first. Enabled by default and toggleable under Account › Settings › Downloads › Prioritize Delisted Apps in Search.
- **Centered action morph & equalized progress rings**: Align action pills, cloud buttons and progress rings on one centered column, morph pill buttons around their center into the loading/download spinner, and match the progress track and progress arc stroke width.
- **Swipe animations & five-second Undo**: Revealed swipe icons play native Core Animation sequences (with static icons when Reduce Motion is on). Swipe-deleting downloads replaces confirmation with a five-second Undo countdown (including consecutive deletions); permanent and batch deletions retain confirmation, while search-history deletion removes the countdown.
- **Vector tab bar & synchronized shimmer**: Switch tabs to adaptive vector animations with balanced strokes on Search and refined Account icon transitions, synchronize monochrome skeleton shimmer waves across rows, and unify tactile row presses and lightweight confirmations.
- **Translate in place (iOS 18+)**: Keep the system translation sheet by default, with opt-in in-place translation under Account › Settings › Appearance & icon › Translation and a Show original toggle.
- **Concise downloads, inline notes & icon toggle**: Separate store version, package version, build number and version ID in task details, expand release notes inline on app pages, and opt out of loading historical version icons under Settings › Downloads › Show Version History Icons while keeping cached icons.

- **Version history reconciliation & cache cleanup**: Reject raw `external_identifier` strings mistaken for marketing versions, reconcile stale or dotless versions against release notes and timestamps, and clear related version caches together.
- iOS / iPadOS 16 and later remain supported, subject to each feature's requirements.

Both packages are unsigned: the standard package includes Live Activities/widgets and needs two App IDs; lite has no extension and needs one. Sign with your own tool before installing.

本次为 **v2.3.5** 稳定性修复与体验升级版：根治 **iOS 16.0–16.2 强链接符号闪退**、**iOS 27.2 beta 2 历史版本加载闪退** 与 **iPadOS 全屏/专业模式导航栏异常**；**TestFlight 现支持切换下载 Apple TV 等多平台测试包**并统一展示单色客户端标识，同时修复大型/多变体游戏误报「产物校验失败，已清理」及详情页顶部虚化异常；在「设置 › 外观与图标」开放**自定义全部 177 个 Apple 商店地区**（支持搜索筛选、勾选、拖拽排序与国旗展示）；并修复 FairPlay 高熵插件误拒、登录 `5020`/2FA 提示、未购免费应用首次获取旧版报错与「应用包」批量导入打断问题。安装包均未签名，请使用自用签名工具签名后安装。

### 🔧 核心修复与优化

- **修复 iOS 16/27 闪退与 iPadOS 专业模式导航异常**
  - 移除强链接 iOS 17+/18+ 的 `UnevenRoundedRectangle` 与全部 `.onGeometryChange` 调用，改用向后兼容路径与几何读取实现，根治 iOS 16.0 / 16.0.2 / 16.2 打开界面或卡片时因动态符号缺失导致的闪退。
  - 修复 iOS 27.2 beta 2 在应用详情页加载历史版本时偶发崩溃的问题（修正版本行布局优先级与骨架屏几何回调防抖阈值）。
  - 修复 iPadOS 全屏及开启「专业模式」后导航栏切换错乱、标题丢失与工具栏按钮跨标签泄露的问题，改为按当前活动标签隔离独立导航栈。
- **TestFlight 支持 Apple TV 多平台下载、校验修复与顶部优化**
  - TestFlight 详情页新增多平台切换（如 `iOS` / `Apple TV`），支持直接下载 Apple TV（tvOS）测试包，并与同一应用的 iOS 测试包独立索引、互不覆盖。
  - 在「下载」「应用包」「存储空间」「包体详情」「解密详情」等全应用页面为 Apple TV 等非 iPhone 包并列展示单色客户端图标（紧邻单色 TestFlight 图标）；点击 TestFlight 任务与安装包详情均可查看来源、客户端与对应最低系统版本（如 `tvOS`）；Apple TV 测试包下载后与常规商店包一致不显示「安装」按钮且不触发自动安装。
  - 修复 TestFlight 下载大型/多变体游戏（如多架构或超大二进制包）误报「产物校验失败，已清理」的问题：改用流式读取 Mach-O 头部前缀并兼容 FAT 32/64 位架构 `cryptid` 校验，修正替换 SINF 计数与完整变体（`packages.full`）筛选逻辑。
  - 修复进入 TestFlight 应用详情页时顶部状态栏与封面衔接处出现浅色虚化断层的显示异常，改用不透明模糊与导航栏原生外观平滑衔接。
- **设置开放自定义 177 个商店地区（支持搜索筛选与排序）**
  - 在「设置 › 外观与图标 › 商店地区」开放自定义管理搜索页显示的地区列表，覆盖全部 **177** 个 Apple App Store 商店地区（补齐 `AF`、`LI`）。
  - 支持按中文名称、英文名称或 ISO‑2 地区代码实时搜索筛选（精确匹配代码优先置顶）、点击勾选、拖拽排序、国旗与代码同屏展示及一键「恢复默认」（至少保留 1 个地区）。
- **修复 FairPlay 解密误拒、首次获取旧版报错与批量导入体验**
  - 修复专业模式本机 FairPlay 解密部分高熵插件二进制（如 `_codecs_cn`）时被误判校验失败的问题，补充基于解码后指令特征的放行校验。
  - 完善 App Store 登录诊断与错误文案：记录 `SAPSigner` 失败阶段详情，修正 `5020` 与双重认证提示文案，避免误导。
  - 修复未获取过的免费应用首次「获取」并加载历史版本时因 Apple 许可延迟偶发失败的问题（获取许可后自动清理旧缓存并执行短退避重试）。

### English

**v2.3.5** delivers key stability fixes and highly requested improvements: eliminates **iOS 16.0–16.2 strong-linked symbol crashes**, **iOS 27.2 beta 2 version-history crashes**, and **iPadOS full-screen / Pro mode toolbar & navigation bugs**; adds **multi-platform TestFlight downloads (including Apple TV)** with monochrome client badges, fixes false validation rejections on large/multi-variant games, and polishes the TestFlight detail top blur; opens a searchable, reorderable **177-region Storefront picker** under Settings › Appearance & icon; and resolves FairPlay high-entropy false rejections, login `5020`/2FA messaging, first-time free-app license retries, and multi-IPA batch import interruptions. Both packages are unsigned—sign with your own tool before installing.

#### Fixes & Improvements Since v2.3.4

- **Fix iOS 16/27 Crashes & iPadOS Pro Mode Navigation**
  - Removes strong-linked iOS 17+/18+ `UnevenRoundedRectangle` and all `.onGeometryChange` usages in favor of backward-compatible paths and geometry observers, resolving launch and view crashes on iOS 16.0 / 16.0.2 / 16.2.
  - Fixes a crash on iOS 27.2 beta 2 when loading version history on App Detail by stabilizing row layout priorities and shimmer geometry change thresholds.
  - Fixes missing titles, broken navigation, and leaked cross-tab toolbars in iPadOS full-screen & Pro mode by isolating a single active `NavigationStack` per tab.
- **TestFlight Apple TV Support, Validation & Hero Blur Fix**
  - Adds platform switching (`iOS` / `Apple TV`, etc.) on TestFlight detail pages to download Apple TV (tvOS) beta IPAs alongside iOS builds, indexed cleanly per `(bundle, platform)`.
  - Places monochrome platform icons beside the monochrome TestFlight icon across **Downloads**, **Packages**, **Storage**, **Package Info**, and **Decryption Detail**; displays source, client platform, and accurate minimum OS (e.g., `tvOS`) in task & package details; hides the Install button and skips Auto-Install for Apple TV IPAs just like regular App Store Apple TV downloads.
  - Fixes false "validation failed, cleaned up" errors on large or multi-variant TestFlight games via streaming Mach-O header prefix reads, FAT 32/64-bit `cryptid` inspection, accurate SINF replacement counting, and `packages.full`-first variant selection.
  - Eliminates the light top-edge blur band on TestFlight detail pages using opaque hero blur and native navigation bar appearance syncing.
- **Customizable 177 Storefront Regions with Search & Reorder**
  - Adds **Settings › Appearance & icon › Storefront Regions** covering all **177** Apple App Store regions (including `AF` and `LI`).
  - Supports instant search by localized name, English name, or ISO‑2 code (with exact ISO‑2 matches ranked first), tap-to-toggle, drag-to-reorder, flag + code display, and one-tap **Reset to Defaults**.
- **FairPlay, Login/License Retry & Batch Import Fixes**
  - Fixes on-device FairPlay decryption falsely rejecting legitimate high-entropy plugin binaries (such as `_codecs_cn`) by accepting verified decrypted instruction streams.
  - Improves App Store sign-in `5020` / 2FA messaging and adds staged `SAPSigner` failure diagnostics.
  - Automatically invalidates stale version caches and performs short backoff retries after acquiring a free app license so first-time older-version fetches no longer fail on transient `9610` delays.
  - Fixes multi-IPA batch import in **Packages** prematurely opening a detail sheet mid-batch, adding live `(done/total)` progress, batch completion toast, and a dismissible error banner.

#### Official Telegram Channel & GitHub Issues Archive

Testing with a secondary Apple Account first is recommended, and never share pairing files, tokens, or unencrypted backups (see [README_EN — TestFlight Experimental](README_EN.md#testflight-experimental)).

显示版本 **0.5**，构建 **1**；内部发布修订 **0.5.0**。

这个版本的主题是「找得到、看得懂、拿得走」：

- **全局文件搜索**：跨 App 搜索用户文件，结果边扫边出；支持文件名 / 相对路径 / App 名、类型与最小大小筛选、路径 / 大小 / 最新排序。结果可原地预览或打开所在目录，扫描中可取消。
- **空间变化**：按「较上次 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天」比较，按增长排序并显示合计占用与净变化；新增全部 App 合计趋势图，单 App 详情保留当前大小、较上次、近 7 天与扫描历史。
- **文件审计与导出**：大文件 / 重复文件按 App 分组，重复项经 SHA-256 确认；清理时每个 App 至少保留一份，删除进入空间透镜回收站。导出中心可分享或存储到「文件」，目标写入完成才记成功，取消 / 失败会清理临时目录。
- **安全与一致性**：跨 App 的相同文件不再被当成可互相替代；重复清理不能选中某个 App 的最后一份；上次中断的导出在重开后显示「已中断」；清理 14 个无用本地化 key，中英文 813 个 key 对齐。
- **界面**：修复空间变化页底部被悬浮 Tab Bar 遮挡；补充全局搜索、空间趋势、导出选择面板的中英文文案。

验证：23 个本地测试程序、9 条模拟器 UI 流程、Debug 模拟器与 Release arm64 构建、`xcodebuild analyze` 全部通过，编译警告 0 条。

已知边界：本轮 IPA 未签名，未在真机安装；超大 App 的冷扫描耗时、App Group 签名、分享 / 存储到「文件」以及强制中断场景仍需真机验收。空间趋势样本不足时显示「—」，这是预期行为。

**遇到问题或有建议，欢迎到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/hseons/WQManager/issues) 提出**。请尽量附上系统版本、App 名称、复现步骤和截图；崩溃日志可配合附件中的 dSYM 定位。

附件为**未签名 IPA**、SHA-256 和 dSYM，请按项目说明保留 App Group 权限重新签名后安装。

apps.localizedDescription:
Andarium runs the Android system on iPhone and iPad. It is built on the Kernarium runtime, which runs a real Linux kernel natively and emulates only the code of the apps, with graphics drawn through Metal.

versions.localizedDescription:

apps.name: WQ Files
apps.subtitle: File manager for iOS 26 and 27 (worse_query)
apps.localizedDescription:
File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26 and 27, built on the worse_query sandbox technique. No jailbreak and no kernel exploit.

• Browse every app's data container, app groups, extension and daemon containers
• Plist editor and hex viewer/editor; edits are backed up first
• Select, move across apps, compress and extract ZIPs; import files and whole folders
• Syntax highlighting, SQLite viewer and media player
• Back up, restore and clear app data; AirDrop backups as ZIP
• Cache cleaner
• Shortcuts actions for files, cache cleaning and app backups

iOS 26 and 27 (tested on 26.7.1, 27.0.1 and 27.2.1; on iOS 26, System Data and System Groups are not available). Needs a signer that keeps the App Group entitlement (AltStore, SideStore or Impactor; not Sideloadly).

versions.localizedDescription: Shortcuts actions for files and apps (list, get, save, copy, move, rename, delete, clean caches, back up), a working update check, and many fixes from a full code review: safer restores and imports, fewer hangs, faster lists.
Imports Apps Manager backups (.adbk), says when another app is using a file instead of showing errno 35, and keeps an app's database and its -wal/-shm files together.

Optional App Store icons for other apps (Settings → App Store Icons), fixes apps with one-word bundle ids (like Pinterest) and the empty gap above the Apps list on iOS 27, and keeps the Backups tab working on iOS 27 beta 5.
Custom inspectors (read-only JavaScript, install from a .zip), your own folders and files in the Cache Cleaner, and Japanese.
Fixes LiveContainer setups where every folder was refused, SQLite restore with -wal files, lossless SQLite and plist edits, and backups listed newest first.
Works inside LiveContainer again. Cache Cleaner: Clean is ready after a scan, plus Invert Selection. Wi-Fi uploads stop with sharing.
Recognizes iOS 27.3 beta 2+, where Apple patched worse_query. The access cache repairs itself when another app in the App Group broke it.
Show Folder Sizes, empty folder hints, Colored Cards with a pickable color, themed tiles; WQ Files is back in the Files app; fixes wrong app names on iOS 26.5 and the Crash Logs note.
Apps and Cache Cleaner scans are fast again (more than twice as fast as 0.9.11 and 0.9.12).
Wi-Fi Sharing: browse, download and upload files from any browser on the same Wi-Fi. Themes with importable .wqtheme files, Recent folders and files, progress bars, and a fix for a frozen screen.
Vietnamese translation. Apps and Clean scans keep running across tabs and app restarts, with Pause/Resume and a spinner or clock in the tab bar.
Fixes installed apps missing from Apps, App Data and Extension Data (e.g. on iOS 26.5).
App Groups now show their names on iOS 27.2+. Plain Background option, dark and tinted app icon, files you can't open are dimmed, and a clear notice on iOS 18 and older.
Reset Access Cache is now in Settings → Troubleshooting (both designs). The Log explains why access is blocked and logs a repeated failure only once.

New design: Home with container cards, tabs for Apps, Clean and Backups, Settings behind the gear. The previous design stays available (Settings → New Design). New screens translated into every language.

New: Search Inside Folders, Largest Files, Get Info, Duplicate, Copy to Folder, Favorites, Reopen Last Folder, update notice, Extract and Open for ZIPs, Thai. Safer SQLite save and app restore. Fixed: app backups could come out empty; app names and missing app folders on iOS versions with an unknown app database layout.

New: iOS 27.3 beta, Turkish, flags in the language list, Replace All when importing several files, Rename in Select, restore edited backups. Many safety fixes from a code review (folder delete, SQLite backups, ZIP, hex and plist editors, media).

New: delete folders with everything in them (backed up, restorable), Polish and Russian, filters in App Data, version in the device strip, Reset Access Cache. Fixed: backups with sockets, Share as ZIP of app folders, app names.
New: startup check (stops with what failed instead of empty lists when access breaks), Recently Deleted under Backups. Cache Cleaner progress bar.
New: edit SQLite databases (Edit, then Save writes back with a backup and integrity check). Korean translation. Fixed: Arabic corrections, empty app lists after an iOS update.

Now in Simplified Chinese, Arabic, German, Italian and Spanish, with a Language setting. New: Import as Backup, Keep Data Before Restore, media streams instead of copying, offloaded apps and App Bundles (iOS 27). Apps and the Cache Cleaner reopen instantly.

Select, move across apps, compress and extract ZIPs; import several files or whole folders. New: syntax highlighting, media player, Apps filter, bundle IDs and Copy Bundle ID, restore from App Backups, Allow Deleting and Show Item Counts settings. Fixed: iOS 26.5 app list, deleting locked files. Signing: use AltStore, SideStore or Impactor (Sideloadly drops the App Group).

Apps show up in seconds on every iOS version (no more long first scan); full scans only when needed and after you agree. New: sorting, A–Z sidebar, read-only SQLite viewer, swipe to delete, signing check at launch. Preliminary iOS 26 support.
iOS 27.2: app names are back. iOS 26 (26.0 – 26.7.2) is supported. Faster scans that are remembered, swipe to delete in the file browser, and a more detailed Log.
Cooler, faster scans (one shared pass, fewer cores); manage and delete backups, stop a cache clean, cancel ZIP exports; checked backups and restores; signing help in the README. Requires iOS 27.
AltStore/SideStore source; safer saves and restores (rollback, interrupted-restore recovery, no overwriting changed files); Log shows version, device and iOS.
Plist editor, hex viewer/editor, Open As, search bar, Home button, readable paths.
Safer backups and restores; large files are streamed.
Fixed: apps you installed were missing.
First release.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Camlo v1.3.4 (Build 27)

### 彻底修复 iOS 真机锁屏景深破框不触发 (#7, #3)
- **定位并满足 `WallpaperKit` 原生景深白名单校验**：通过逆向 iOS `WallpaperKit.framework` (`supportsDepthEffect`)，确认系统会在切换真机锁屏前强制检查路径中是否包含 `Clownfish` 标记（`ParameterizedCA` 检查 `wallpaper.ca` 所在 `.wallpaper` 路径；`LayeredAnimation` 检查 `floatingAnimationFileNameKey` 指向的 `Floating.ca` 路径）；若不满足，系统即记录 `Depth not supported, collapsing floating view into foreground view` 并将前景层降级压到系统时间之后（导致在 Camlo App 内能遮挡 `09:41`，回到系统真机锁屏却总是时间压人物）。
- **双引擎与历史壁纸自动原地自愈**：现已全面升级 3D `ParameterizedCA`（`7920.Camlo_Clownfish_3D-...wallpaper`）与滑动变身/实况 `LayeredAnimation`（`7400.Clownfish_WWDC_2022-...wallpaper` / `7400.WWDC_2022_Clownfish_Floating-...ca`）；**已保存在金库或外部导入的旧版 `.tendies` 壁纸**在升级至 `v1.3.4` 后会自动原地自愈迁移，无需重新创作。

### 重塑 3D 陀螺仪 (`ParameterizedCA`) 立体视差与消重影 (#3)
- **消除主体背后「双重轮廓重影」**：将背景 (`BG`) 与前景抠图 (`FG`) 的静止超采样倍率对齐为严格 `1:1`（`1.065x`），彻底解决旧版 `1.104x` 与 `1.052x` 尺寸不一致导致静止或晃动时人物头部、剑柄外侧露出一圈较大残影的问题。
- **自动背景遮挡补全 (Occlusion Inpainting)**：在编译 3D 陀螺仪壁纸及金库自愈旧包时，自动对被前景抠图遮住的背景区域执行多尺度金字塔与水平扫线上下文补全，晃动手机错位时背后露出自然衔接的天空/云海/背景纹理，不再出现克隆人影。
- **增加 `sublayerTransform` 3D 透视与立体倾斜**：收窄合理平移幅度并加入 `transform.rotation.x` / `transform.rotation.y` 空间倾角变换，还原接近原生的立体视差体验。
- **云端全部 76 套官方 `.tendies` 同步升级**：涵盖「次元 3D」「海岸海报 3D」「iPhone Duo」「馆藏名画」共 76 套官方云端包已全部重新编译并通过 `CAPackage` 与 SHA-256 校验。

---

### Fix On-Device Lock Screen Clock-Depth (#7, #3)
- **Satisfies `WallpaperKit` `Clownfish` Depth Gate**: Disassembling `WallpaperKit.framework` (`supportsDepthEffect`) confirmed that iOS collapses `FLOATING` behind the system clock (`"Depth not supported, collapsing floating view into foreground view"`) unless `"Clownfish"` appears in the `ParameterizedCA` bundle path or `LayeredAnimation` `Floating.ca` path. Both Camlo compilers (`7920.Camlo_Clownfish_3D-...wallpaper` & `7400.WWDC_2022_Clownfish_Floating-...ca`), all 76 cloud `.tendies` packs, and automatic in-place Vault/import self-healing now conform cleanly.

### Overhaul 3D Gyroscope (`ParameterizedCA`) Spatial Depth & Ghosting Fix (#3)
- **Exact 1:1 Rest Registration (`1.065x`)**: Aligns `Camlo_BG_Overscan` and `Camlo_FG_Overscan` scale identically so subjects register pixel-for-pixel at neutral rest.
- **Exterior-Inward Background Occlusion Inpainting**: Automatically inpaints the occluded region behind `cutout_lock.png` / `cutout_unlock.png` in background JPEGs so tilting reveals continuous background scenery instead of a duplicated ghost silhouette.
- **True 3D Perspective Tilt**: Adds `sublayerTransform` perspective projection (`m34 = -0.0010`), matched `zPosition="0"` parallax planes, and subtle `transform.rotation.x/y` angular tilt alongside tight balanced translation.

> ⚠️ **iOS Compatibility Reminder**: On-device Computer-Free Direct Write supports **iOS / iPadOS 26.0 – 27.3 beta 1** (Apple patched `worse_query` in `27.3 beta 2`). Creation, 120Hz preview, and `.tendies` export continue to work on all versions.

## Camlo v1.3.3 (Build 26)

### 修复 SideStore / AltStore 个人免费 Apple ID 安装失败 (#6)
- **修复 `appIdName` 非法字符报错**：感谢 `@linszx` 的精准定位！此前主 `Info.plist` 顶层 `CFBundleDisplayName` 设为 `"开幕 Camlo"`，导致 SideStore / AltStore（底层 `SideSign` / `AltSign`）在向苹果开发者接口 `addAppId` 注册 App ID 时因包含中文及空格而触发 `An invalid value '开幕 Camlo' was provided for the parameter 'appIdName'` 安装失败。
- **纯 ASCII 顶层名称 + 原生 `InfoPlist.strings` 本地化**：现已将主 `Info.plist` 顶层 `CFBundleDisplayName` 与 `apps.json` `name` 统一改为纯 ASCII 的 `"Camlo"`，同时启用 `LSHasLocalizedDisplayName` 并通过 `InfoPlist.xcstrings` 生成 `zh-Hans.lproj/InfoPlist.strings` 与 `en.lproj/InfoPlist.strings`——SideStore / AltStore 个人免费签可顺利完成 App ID 注册并保留 `App Group` 权限，简体中文桌面图标仍优雅显示为 **「开幕 Camlo」**。
- 完整继承 `v1.3.2` 对 iPhone Duo 折叠屏 `retinaMultiplier` 与内屏偏移的修复、10 套原创「次元 3D」二次元交互云端包与金库旧包自动原地自愈。

### Fix SideStore / AltStore Free Apple ID Installation Failure (#6)
- **Fixed `appIdName` Validation Error**: Thanks to `@linszx` for the detailed root-cause report! SideStore / AltStore pass the top-level `Info.plist` `CFBundleDisplayName` directly to Apple's `addAppId` Developer Portal API, which rejects non-ASCII characters (`"开幕 Camlo"`).
- **Pure ASCII Bundle Display Name + Localized `InfoPlist.strings`**: Top-level `CFBundleDisplayName` and `apps.json` `name` are now `"Camlo"`, while `zh-Hans.lproj/InfoPlist.strings` (via `InfoPlist.xcstrings` + `LSHasLocalizedDisplayName = true`) preserves the localized Chinese Home Screen label (`"开幕 Camlo"`). Free Apple ID sideloading via SideStore / AltStore now registers seamlessly with `App Group` entitlements preserved.
- Includes all `v1.3.2` iPhone Duo scaling/centering fixes, 10 official 3D Anime Cloud packs, and automatic Vault self-healing.

> ⚠️ **iOS Compatibility Reminder**: On-device Computer-Free Direct Write supports **iOS / iPadOS 26.0 – 27.3 beta 1** (Apple patched `worse_query` in `27.3 beta 2`). Creation, 120Hz preview, and `.tendies` export continue to work on all versions.

## Camlo v1.3.2 (Build 25)

### 修复 iPhone Duo（折叠屏）所有壁纸缩小为 1/3 与展开内屏偏移问题 (#4)
- **彻底修复缩放比例 (`retinaMultiplier: 3 → 1`)**：在 `WallpaperKit` `<wallpapers>` 多屏描述中，由于 Camlo 以逻辑点坐标（外屏 `466×678`、内屏 `951×669`）编译底层 Core Animation 图层树，将其 `retinaMultiplier` 设为 `3` 会导致系统 `WKParameterizedCAPackageLoader` 将绘制尺寸再除以 `3`，从而把壁纸缩小为约 `1/3`（实测 `951×669` px）；现已修正为 `retinaMultiplier = 1` 并保留完整物理像素资源。
- **修复展开内屏居中偏移 (`BACKGROUND_INNER` / `FLOATING_INNER` position 对齐)**：在折叠屏展开状态下，`WKParameterizedCAWallpaperRepresentedView` 会将 `BACKGROUND_INNER` / `FLOATING_INNER` 直接挂入外屏 `__capRootLayer__` 的 `hostingLayer`（中心点 `233 339`），旧版 `475.5 334.5` 坐标会导致向右下角明显偏移；现统一对齐为 `233 339`，实现外屏/内屏严丝合缝全屏铺满。
- **Duo 导出分辨率升级**：外屏素材采样升级至原生 `@3x`（`1398×2034`），展开内屏升级至高清（`2282×1606`）；10 套官方云端 iPhone Duo 双屏壁纸（`18951`–`18960`）已全量重新编译并通过 `CAPackage` 渲染校验。

- **消除主体背后「双重轮廓重影」**：将背景 (`BG`) 与前景抠图 (`FG`) 的静止超采样倍率对齐为严格 `1:1`（`1.065x`），彻底解决旧版 `1.104x` 与 `1.052x` 尺寸不一致导致静止或晃动时人物头部、剑柄外侧露出一圈较大残影的问题。
- **自动背景遮挡补全 (Occlusion Inpainting)**：在编译 3D 陀螺仪壁纸及金库自愈旧包时，自动对被前景抠图遮住的背景区域执行多尺度金字塔与水平扫线上下文补全，晃动手机错位时背后露出自然衔接的天空/云海/背景纹理，不再出现克隆人影。

- **Exact 1:1 Rest Registration (`1.065x`)**: Aligns `Camlo_BG_Overscan` and `Camlo_FG_Overscan` scale identically so subjects register pixel-for-pixel at neutral rest.

  - 支持在过滤设置中按需开启屏蔽首页推荐与动态流中的充电专属及提前看视频（默认关闭）。

  - 搜索页支持原生 TabBar 形态切换与宽屏多栏发现/结果网格；「我的」页内嵌原生分组搜索栏。

- **视频详情页 UP 主关注角标优化**：移除头像外圈描边，改为右下角带背景镂空环的微角标（未关注为主题色 `+`，已关注平滑切换为克制的 `✓`）。
- **卡片视觉更轻盈**：首页有边框自适应布局与动态页瀑布流/等高网格卡片统一去除厚重阴影，并调低描边不透明度（浅色 `0.06` / 深色 `0.10`）。
- **根 TabBar 过渡与内嵌弹窗打磨**：
  - 修复详情页返回时根 TabBar 闪现及搜索 Tab 对接异常。
  - 展开态竖屏与双栏分屏下的分P、合集、分集与评论回复弹窗采用原生 Liquid Glass 内嵌卡片，弹窗弹出时自动隐藏底部工具栏并在关闭后即时恢复页面滚动。

- 修复动态页下拉刷新偶发被取消或阻塞的问题。
- 修复评论楼中楼回复取消加载后状态卡死、再次进入无法自动重试的问题。
- 修复外部深链跳转用户主页路由、多账号切换及部分搜索筛选按钮在深浅模式下的文字反色问题。
